nodes.label: Design System Rule - tokens only
nodes.rationale: All colors, fonts and type sizes must come from design/figma-tokens.md; never invent hex values, font families or px sizes outside that file, because it mirrors the client's existing Figma prototype.

nodes.label: Component Kit Rule
nodes.rationale: If a piece of UI appears on more than one screen it is a component: put it in the kit, never copy-paste into a second page. A kit component owns its own look; pages pass data and variants, not styling.

nodes.label: Kit Components Are Presentational
nodes.rationale: Kit components take fake data via props so the swap to real data is a page-level change.

nodes.label: Literal /portal Segment, Not a Route Group
nodes.rationale: Route groups contribute nothing to the URL, so (portal)/accreditations collides with the public /accreditations and the dev server 500s. The literal segment also buys a fail-closed matcher ["/portal/:path*"].

nodes.label: Never Run Git
nodes.rationale: The project owner runs git add/commit/push themselves; the agent prints the command as one copy-pasteable block instead.

nodes.label: Commit Message Rules
nodes.rationale: Simple, plain, one line. No conventional-commit prefixes, no Co-Authored-By, no Generated-with trailer, no multi-line body unless asked.
